hero.tagline: <brand>Muse</brand> is a product studio in Riyadh.
hero.subtitle: We bring together strategy, design, engineering and AI to turn ideas and challenges into digital products made for real people.

intents.heading: How can we help?
intents.lede: Every project starts somewhere different. Where are you today?

build.title: Start something new
build.body: You have an idea, a plan, or a problem worth solving. We help you shape it, design it, and build it into a product people can actually use.

improve.title: Improve a product
improve.body: You already have a product, and you sense it could be more. We help you understand what's holding it back, then improve it, or rebuild the parts that need it.

ai.title: Explore AI Transformation
ai.body: AI is full of promise, and full of noise. We help you find where it genuinely helps your business and your customers, then build it into how you work.

intents.capabilityLink: Looking for a specific capability? See what we bring together below.

capabilities.heading: What we bring together
capabilities.lede: One team, five disciplines. Most projects draw on several at once.

strategyDiscovery.title: Product Strategy & Discovery
strategyDiscovery.body: Understanding your users, your business, and the problem itself, so we build the right thing before we build anything.

design.title: Product & Experience Design
design.body: Interfaces and experiences that feel clear, considered, and natural to use, in Arabic and English alike.

productEngineering.title: Product Engineering
productEngineering.body: Reliable, well-crafted software, built by senior engineers who stay close to the product and to you.

ai.title: AI
ai.body: Practical intelligence inside products and workflows: features and systems that quietly make things easier for the people using them.

gamification.title: Gamification & Experience
gamification.body: The craft of motivation. We design the moments, feedback, and rewards that help people form real habits with a product, instead of trying it once and drifting away.

approach.heading: Our approach
approach.lede: A few beliefs shape everything we make.

beliefs.title: Start with people
beliefs.body: We spend time understanding your users and your business before we design anything. Good decisions come from context, not templates.

beliefs.title: Design and engineering, one conversation
beliefs.body: The people who design your product and the people who build it work side by side, so ideas survive the journey from sketch to software.

beliefs.title: Show, early and often
beliefs.body: You'll see real progress from the first weeks, and you'll always be talking directly with the people doing the work.

beliefs.title: Care for the quiet details
beliefs.body: An empty screen, an error message, a first-time experience: the small moments are where products earn trust, so we design them with the same care as the big ones.

whyMuse.heading: Why Muse
whyMuse.paragraph1: We're a small, multidisciplinary team based in Riyadh: product thinkers, designers, and engineers working under one roof. We're Saudi, we hire Saudi, and we understand how products need to feel for people here, because it's home.
whyMuse.paragraph2: Being small is a choice. It keeps design and engineering in the same room instead of passing work between departments, keeps specialist depth in AI and in gamification and experience design close to every project, and means the people you talk to are the people building your product.

fromStudio.heading: From the studio
fromStudio.lede: Products, experiments, and writing from our own work.

manifesto.heading: The next decade of software gets decided in the next two years.
manifesto.paragraph1: The cost of building good software is collapsing. That doesn't help you on its own. It means the gap between the companies that move and the ones that plan is about to get permanent.
manifesto.paragraph2: You could drive that from inside. Most won't, and not for lack of ambition. Day to day operations always win the calendar.
manifesto.paragraph3: We're not interested in your roadmap for this quarter. We're interested in the one that matters in five years.

whoWeBuildFor.heading: The teams we work with aren't a general audience.
whoWeBuildFor.body: They're <role>founders</role> shipping a first product, and <role>operators</role> trying to get an AI initiative out of pilot purgatory.

Home.ticker: Nothing ships that we wouldn't use ourselves

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
items.a: New products from the first idea, existing products that need care or a rethink, and focused work in design, engineering, AI, or engagement. We work with founders and established organizations.

items.q: Who will we actually be working with?
items.a: A small senior team. The people you meet in the first conversation are the people who will design and build your product.

With a conversation. We listen, ask questions, and take time to understand what you're trying to achieve. If we believe we can genuinely help, we come back with a clear picture of how we'd approach it.

items.q: What does AI Transformation mean at Muse?
items.a: Finding where AI genuinely helps your business, operations, customers, or product, and building it in thoughtfully. We care most about what your team will actually use day to day.

The psychology of engagement, applied with care. New tools compete with old habits, so we design the onboarding, feedback, and reward systems that help a change stick in products, learning, and workplaces.

hero.title: Riyadh-built. Globally standard.
hero.subtitle: A product company working with businesses that want it built properly.

moment.lead: Saudi Arabia's economy is going through a moment that doesn't repeat itself. Companies are being built from scratch, and a generation of founders and operators is building something genuinely new.
moment.continuation: Most of what gets shipped still isn't built to a standard that lasts. That's the gap Muse was built for.

about.paragraph1: Muse is a product company based in Riyadh. We work with businesses that want their product built properly.
about.paragraph2: That covers product, design, engineering and brand. Some engagements run a few weeks, some run a year. What does not change is the standard: real data, every state designed, nothing shipped that we would not use ourselves.
about.paragraph3: We are Saudi, we hire Saudis, and we would rather see good work stay in the Kingdom.

About.mission: Build software that people here actually want to use, and raise the standard of what gets shipped in the Kingdom.
About.vision: A Saudi product company known for shipping exceptional software, whose products are used every day and whose work sets the bar locally.

values.name: Craftsmanship
values.copy: The details nobody is paid to notice get done anyway.

values.name: Innovation
values.copy: Shown in what we ship, never claimed in a sentence.

values.name: Quality
values.copy: There is a written bar, and nothing goes out below it.

values.name: Long term thinking
values.copy: We choose the option that is better in two years.

values.name: Trust
values.copy: We say what is true, including when it costs us the work.

beliefs.heading: What we believe
items: Digital transformation isn't optional anymore. It's the difference between growing and getting replaced by someone who moved faster.
There are three kinds of businesses today: digitally absent, digitally competent, and digitally native. Most are stuck in the middle.
The only way to build something that lasts is to treat design, engineering, and AI as one discipline, not three separate handoffs.
Most companies don't lack ambition. They lack a team that can execute at a global standard, from right here in Saudi Arabia.

team.name: Abdullah Al Subaie
team.title: Chief Executive Officer
team.bio: Abdullah leads Muse Studios' overall strategy and client partnerships, setting the direction for how the studio grows and who it chooses to work with. He's focused on building a team that can execute at a global standard while staying rooted in the Saudi market Muse was built to serve.

team.name: Mohammad Aamir
team.title: Chief Technology Officer
team.bio: Mohammad leads engineering and product delivery at Muse Studios, setting the technical bar for every client engagement. He's focused on keeping the studio's output fast without cutting corners, and on holding the same standard internally that Muse asks of the work it takes on.
